name: aws-guard
description: Guards aws CLI calls made through Claude Code's Bash tool: requires an explicit non-prod profile and a narrowing --query on reads, hard-denies risky commands, asks on mutations, fails closed and keeps an audit log.

blocked_profile_pattern.title: Blocked profile pattern
blocked_profile_pattern.description: Case-insensitive regular expression. Calls using an AWS profile whose name matches are always denied. Leave empty for the default, "prod".

extra_denied_commands.title: Extra denied commands
extra_denied_commands.description: Comma-separated commands to always deny, written as service or service:operation-prefix (for example rds,ec2:terminate-). Leave empty for none.

require_query.title: Require --query on read calls
require_query.description: Deny describe-/list-/get-/head-/lookup-/batch-get- calls that have no --query, or whose --query selects everything.

use_environment_profile.title: Use the AWS_PROFILE environment variable
use_environment_profile.description: Treat AWS_PROFILE from Claude Code's environment as the profile when a call names none. Off by default, so every call must name its profile.
